Trails.Name: Lost in the Woods (Lower) Uphill Route
Lost in the Woods (Upper) Uphill Route

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Thursday, November 19, 2026 2:00 PM – Discovery Chair (11) is open, conditions permitting. We've picked up 20 to 32 inches of new snow in the last 24 hours, and it's still coming down. It is whiteout conditions here at Main Lodge with strong southwest winds, low visibility and temps in the high teens to low 20s. This storm cycle is projected to continue all day through Friday morning, setting us up for a beautiful weekend. The snow is DEEP so ride with a buddy and keep them in sight.

Once this storm cycle passes, our teams are planning to significantly expand terrain and will work to have lifts open out of Canyon Lodge by this Saturday.

Follow along on our Storm Tracker. There is no uphill skiing or skinning access anywhere on the resort at this time.

Conditions: Snow, strong southwest winds with gusts in the 60s and cold temps. Deep, wind-affected new snow covers all open terrain, with drifts building in exposed areas.
Visibility: Low, with whiteout conditions at times.
Lift Status: Discovery Express (11) is open, conditions permitting.
Safety: The snow is DEEP. Ride with a partner, keep them in sight and avoid tree wells. Remember - this is our first big storm of the season and the snow is light. Early season obstacles are still present under the new snow. Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is: 760.934.0611
Road Conditions: Heavy snow fell overnight, so roads may be snowy and icy this morning. Always be prepared for winter mountain driving and watch for icy patches in shaded areas. Keep your distance from heavy machinery clearing roads and parking lots. Check our Road Conditions page for the latest status.
_inspectorSnowReport.Alert: There is NO UPHILL SKIINNG/SKINNING ACCESS at this time.
